[Subtitle(text="「我正准备回到城外的军营里，特蕾西娅殿下。」", x=500, y=370, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]

[Subtitle(text="「你总是这么来去匆匆啊，食腐者。你是不想与我们相聚吗？」", x=100, y=370, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
[subtitle]
[image]
[Image(image="27_i12",fadetime=1, xScaleFrom=1.7, yScaleFrom=1.7,x=490, y=-300)]

[Subtitle(text="「我可没你那么清闲，血魔。伦蒂尼姆之外屯着十万大军，\n我和我的将士们没有一刻能够松懈。」", x=500, y=370, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
[subtitle]
[Image(image="27_i12",fadetime=1, xScaleFrom=1.7, yScaleFrom=1.7,x=-590, y=-380)]

[Subtitle(text="「他的脑袋还得在脖子上待一段时间。别让城内的维多利亚军队给我们增加麻烦。」", x=300, y=370, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
[subtitle]
[image]
[Image(image="27_i12",fadetime=1, xScaleFrom=1.7, yScaleFrom=1.7,x=-590, y=-380)]

[Subtitle(text="「那好吧。不过，你不觉得还有人没派上用场吗？」", x=100, y=370, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
[subtitle]
[image]
[Image(image="27_i12",fadetime=1, xScaleFrom=1.7, yScaleFrom=1.7,x=390, y=-100)]
[ImageTween(image="27_i12", fadetime=0.5, xScaleFrom=1.7, yScaleFrom=1.7, xScaleTo=1.6, yScaleTo=1.6, xTo=390, yTo=-120, duration=10)]
[Blocker(a=0.5, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.5, block=true)]
[delay(time=0.51)]
[Subtitle(text="「你说我吗，血魔？我接下来可有大事要办，对吧，殿下们？」", x=500, y=370, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
[subtitle]
[image]
[Image(image="27_i12",fadetime=1, xScaleFrom=1.2, yScaleFrom=1.2)]
[ImageTween(image="27_i12", fadetime=0.5, xScaleFrom=1.2, yScaleFrom=1.2, xScaleTo=1, yScaleTo=1,duration=50)]
[Subtitle(text="「当然。想要控制伦蒂尼姆，离不开你们每一位的努力。」", x=300, y=600, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
[Subtitle(text="「你派出去的信使都有消息了吗，赦罪师？」", x=300, y=600, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
[subtitle]
[delay(time=1)]
[Subtitle(text="「在曼弗雷德的不懈劝说下，巫妖已在赶来伦蒂尼姆的路上。」", x=300, y=100, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
[Subtitle(text="「仅剩的温迪戈仍在乌萨斯北境对抗精怪。他们心中已没有王庭。」", x=300, y=100, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
[Subtitle(text="「独眼巨人送回了一封信，一如既往，她描述了一个悲惨的场景——伦蒂尼姆被大火撕扯成了三块，碎片大厦倒在数百道闪电之下，而摄政王……是的，她还预言了摄政王殿下的结局。」", x=300, y=100, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
[Subtitle(text="「说出来。」", x=300, y=600, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
[Subtitle(text="「她说她看到了你孤独地死在圣王会西部大堂地下的王座上。」", x=300, y=100, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
[Subtitle(text="「回信给她，感谢她的关心。」", x=300, y=600, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
[Subtitle(text="「继续搜寻石翼魔的消息。但凡能寻到任何遗落的血脉，立刻向他们发出邀请。」", x=300, y=600, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
[Subtitle(text="「委员会将和众王庭一起，确保这场战争的胜利。」", x=300, y=600, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
